CIS 2400 Fall 2026

Welcome to CIS 2400, Introduction to Computer Systems II, for Fall 2026. This course covers systems programming in C, assembly, memory management and the fundamentals every later systems course builds on. Check the schedule regularly for updated readings and due dates.

Course discussion happens on Ed Discussion. Submit assignments through Gradescope. Office hours queue: OHQ.
